en: A black‑and‑white image shows a stone suspension bridge crossing a deep, wooded valley. Massive masonry pylons support the bridge, whose deck is carried by a lattice of vertical hangers and cables. Behind and above the bridge on a hill stands a large medieval stone castle complex with multiple towers and steep roofs. To the right of the castle is a baroque‑style church with a tall spire and cross, and several multi‑storey town buildings. Forested hills form the distant background.
